easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Avenger of Zendikar.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
